title: Ordinary coefficient squares for compactification composites
statement: Fix l,E,o,a, base B, input family X and ordinary integral inputs K [def-sf-integral-realization-assembly-data]. Write rho for the explicit ordinary coefficient maps [def-sf-integral-ordinary-expression-reduction]. For compactifications cf of f:U→V and cfprime of fprime:Uprime→Vprime, a compatible map of their open/proper diagrams x,y,z with cartesian open square, and an expression e on U, rho_(P_y F_cf e) followed by the system compactification exchange equals R of the ordinary ringed compactification exchange followed by rho_(F_cfprime P_x e). For a compactification cf of f:U→V and e,t on U,V, rho_((F_cf e) tensor t) followed by compactification projection equals R of the ordinary ringed compactification projection followed by rho_(F_cf(e tensor P_f t)). Each map is the fixed open/proper composite, not a newly chosen exchange or projection. No realization comparison or completion appears.

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.

proof.text: expand compactificationExchangeFromData: proper exchange on the open image, then proper image of open base change. Obtain the proper-exchange coefficient square by applying the primitive square to formal variables for the open-image objects and inserting the actual open coefficient by naturality. For the open base-change factor, transpose its defining open-adjunction equation. Pullback composition coherence and the unit/counit mate squares identify its reduction; invertibility of the fixed openReduction permits cancellation. This direct mate argument needs no quasi-compactness of the compactification open. Whisker by proper image using ordinaryPushReduction.naturality, and paste the two squares. For projection, expand its three factors: proper projection, proper image of open projection, and open/proper image of the inverse pull compositor with cf.comm. The proper-projection square at formal variables extends to the open-image coefficient and the other child coefficient by naturality in both inputs. The open projection square follows by transposing its prescribed inverse: tensor reduction compatibility and the open unit square identify the two transposes, and openReduction is invertible. Apply inverse pull-composition compatibility to the last factor and transport by cf.comm. Bifunctoriality pastes these three squares and inserts both child coefficients. No completion comparison is used.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryCompactificationSquares
    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o)
    {B : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {X : I → Over B}
    (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left) :
    (∀ {U V U' V' : Over B}
      (f : U ⟶ V) (f' : U' ⟶ V') (cf : Compactification f.left)
      (cf' : Compactification f'.left) (x : U' ⟶ U) (y : V' ⟶ V) (z : cf'.Z ⟶ cf.Z)
      (wi : x.left ≫ cf.i = cf'.i ≫ z) (wp : z ≫ cf.g = cf'.g ≫ y.left)
      (hi : IsPullback x.left cf'.i cf.i z) (e : Expression B I X U),
      (Expression.pull y (.compactSupport f cf e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K ≫
        (compactificationExchange l E o a.compositors a.openComparisons
          cf cf' x.left y.left z wi wp hi).app
            (e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) =
      (calculus l E V'.left).reduction.map
          ((ringedCompactificationExchange l E a.ringedModels a.ringedOpenComparisons
            cf cf' x.left y.left z wi wp hi).app (e.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)) ≫
        (Expression.compactSupport f' cf' (.pull x e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K) ∧
    (∀ {U V : Over B} (f : U ⟶ V) (cf : Compactification f.left)
      (e : Expression B I X U) (t : Expression B I X V),
      (Expression.tensor (.compactSupport f cf e) t).ordinaryReduction l E o a K ≫
        compactificationProjection l E o a.compositors a.openComparisons cf
          (e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K))
          (t.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) =
      (calculus l E V.left).reduction.map
          (ringedCompactificationProjection l E a.ringedModels a.ringedOpenComparisons cf
            (e.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)
            (t.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)) ≫
        (Expression.compactSupport f cf (.tensor e (.pull f t))).ordinaryReduction
          l E o a K)
